KESCO | website = {{URL|uppcl.org}} }} '''Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL)''' is a state government company, responsible for electricity transmission and distribution within the Indian state of [[Uttar Pradesh]].{{Cite web |title=E-government for Improving Performance of Power Sector in India |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Geetika-Goel-2/publication/221229234_E-government_for_Improving_Performance_of_Power_Sector_in_India/links/5707555f08ae04e9708c1327/E-government-for-Improving-Performance-of-Power-Sector-in-India.pdf}} The incumbent chairman is Dr. Ashish Kumar Goel.{{cite web |title=Headquarters / Welcome to Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited, Government of Uttar Pradesh, India. |url=https://uppcl.org/uppcl/en/page/headquarter#:~:text=1.,chairmanuppcl%40gmail.com |website=uppcl.org}} == History == U.P. Power Corporation Limited was incorporated on 30 November 1999{{Cite web |title=U. P. Power Corporation Limited Information - U. P. Power Corporation Limited Company Profile, U. P. Power Corporation Limited News on The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/company/ |access-date=2024-06-10 |website=The Economic Times |language=en}} and commenced its business w.e.f. 15 January 2000.{{Cite web |title=Welcome to Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited, Government of Uttar Pradesh, India. |url=https://uppcl.org/uppcl/en#:~:text=The%20creation%20of%20Uttar%20Pradesh,distribution%20and%20supply%20of%20electricity. |access-date=2024-06-10 |website=uppcl.org}} It was formed as part of restructuring of then Uttar Pradesh State Electricity Board (UPSEB). == Organization == For efficient operation & management, UPPCL is divided six divisions:{{Cite web |title=Organisation Structure / Welcome to Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited, Government of Uttar Pradesh, India. |url=https://uppcl.org/uppcl/en/article/organisation-structure |access-date=2024-09-02 |website=uppcl.org}} * Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited (DVVNL) - Agra Zone Discom * Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited (MVVNL) - Lucknow, Ayodhya Zone Discom * Pashchimanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited (PVVNL) - Meerut Zone Discom * Purvanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited (PUVVNL) - Prayagraj, Varanasi Zone Discom * [[Kanpur Electricity Supply Company]] (KESCO) - [[Kanpur]] City Discom == Power procurement == UPPCL procures power from state government-owned power generators ([[Uttar Pradesh Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam]] & Uttar Pradesh Jal Vidyut Nigam Limited), central government-owned power generators ([[NTPC Limited]] & [[THDC India Limited|THDC Ltd]]) and independent power producers - IPP (mostly private power companies) through [[power purchase agreement]] for lowest per unit cost of electricity. == Financial condition and line losses == The total loss of the UPPCL for the year ended on 31 March 2017 is estimated to be ₹ 8,825 crores. The causes of such poor financial conditions include: * Higher line losses due to ageing over-stressed infrastructure * Pilferage of power at large scale * Inferior quality of transformers and other equipment * Widespread corruption * Inefficient use of IT-enabled infrastructure for administrative as well as technical purposes{{Cite web |title=Theft and Loss of Electricity in an Indian State1 |url=https://leitner.yale.edu/sites/default/files/files/resources/papers/GM_PowerTheft_20120409.pdf}} Discom-wise Aggregate Technical & Commercial (AT&C) Loss / Total line losses (in %) for the period 2010-11: * Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited (DVVNL) - 46.80% * Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited (MVVNL) - 39.10% * Pashchimanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited (PVVNL) - 31.60% * Purvanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited (PUVVNL) - 29.72% == Power plants == In line of [[Power Finance Corporation]], UPPCL created [[Special-purpose entity|Special Purpose Vehicles]] (SPVs): * To attract private investment in the implementation of New Power Plant Projects in the state of Uttar Pradesh * To meet the growing power demand of [[Uttar Pradesh]] state * To procure power at the lowest possible feasible rates The role of SPVs are - * Preparing feasibility report (including Technology, Size, Coal linkages, Land & Water issues), * Clearances (including environment clearances) & land acquisition, etc. These SPVs are transferred to a developer private company through bidding for the lowest per unit cast of selling electricity to UPPCL. UPPCL SPVs: * [[Bara Thermal Power Station|Bara Thermal Power Project]], Prayagraj Power Generation Company Limited (Tehsil - Bara, Distt. Allahabad) - 3 x 660 MW * [[Tanda thermal power plant]] ([[Ambedkar Nagar district]]) 4× 1680 MW, 4× 660 MW * [[Karchana Thermal Power Station]], Sangam Power Generation Company Limited (Tehsil - Karchana, Distt. Allahabad) - 2 x 660 MW (Under Construction) == References == {{Reflist}} [[Category:Electric power distribution network operators in India]] [[Category:Government-owned energy companies of Uttar Pradesh]] [[Category:Companies based in Lucknow]] [[Category:1999 establishments in Uttar Pradesh]] [[Category:Energy companies established in 1999]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1999]]
